bull.b: Conversion of design wins into mass production provides stronger evidence of customer adoption than early-stage bookings alone. With backlog extending into 2027 and several programs expected to generate meaningful annual revenue, this can support more durable product growth.

Strong product-led growth indicates improving traction in Sequans’ core cellular IoT business rather than reliance solely on occasional licensing revenue. Continued expansion in shipped products could improve scale, customer relevance, and operating leverage over the next several quarters.

Exiting the Bitcoin treasury strategy and removing convertible debt-related complexity gives management a clearer financial base for the semiconductor business. A simpler balance sheet can improve capital allocation, reduce volatility, and support investment in IoT and software-defined radio growth.

bear.b: Sequans has not yet demonstrated that its expanding product activity can fund ongoing operations. Continued losses and cash consumption could require further financial actions before breakeven, limiting flexibility to invest in growth and increasing execution pressure.

Lower gross margins reduce the earnings benefit from growing product volumes and make the path to breakeven more dependent on cost reductions or future licensing revenue. If the product mix remains less profitable, revenue growth may not translate efficiently into sustainable earnings.

The NYSE notice creates a structural corporate risk that extends beyond normal operating performance. Sequans must submit a recovery plan and restore compliance within the cure process, adding management distraction and uncertainty around continued exchange listing while the business is still scaling.
